description: Defines classes, templates, and functions for managing D3D11 resources within the ANGLE project, including resource allocation, naming, and type mappings.

classes.name: TypedData
classes.description: Holds a pointer to a D3D11 resource object and its managing ResourceManager11.

classes.name: Resource11Base
classes.description: Template class for managing D3D11 resources with smart pointers, providing safe access and debug naming.

classes.name: Resource11
classes.description: Wrapper for D3D11 resources with ownership semantics, derived from Resource11Base.

classes.name: SharedResource11
classes.description: Shared ownership wrapper for D3D11 resources, allowing copy and move semantics.

classes.name: ResourceManager11
classes.description: Manages allocation, release, and tracking of D3D11 resources.

methods.name: SetDebugName
methods.description: Sets a debug name for a D3D11 resource.

methods.name: allocate
methods.description: Allocates a D3D11 resource based on description and initial data.
